title: Consolidate NAP constants to fix schema.org inconsistencies across all structured data
description: Create a single source of truth for hostel Name, Address, and Phone (NAP) values used in JSON-LD schemas. Currently hardcoded in multiple places (StructuredData.tsx, schema files), causing maintenance issues and potential inconsistencies. Consolidating to site/src/config/nap.ts ensures all schemas reference the same values.
acceptanceCriteria: Create site/src/config/nap.ts exporting NAP constants: hostelName, address (street, city, postalCode, country), phone, email, website
Update site/src/components/StructuredData.tsx to import and use NAP constants instead of hardcoded values
Grep search for hardcoded phone/address strings in site/src/components/ returns zero matches
technicalNotes: File to create: site/src/config/nap.ts with export const NAP = { hostelName, addressLine1, city, postalCode, countryCode, telephone, email }
File to update: site/src/components/StructuredData.tsx — replace all inline NAP references with import { NAP } from '@/config/nap'
Test command: rtk grep -r '\+6012-[0-9]{7}' site/src/components/ (should return 0 results after refactor)

title: Create /digital-nomad landing page with FAQPage schema and DE Rantau visa content
description: Build dedicated landing page for digital nomads and remote workers considering the DE Rantau visa program in JB. Includes FAQPage JSON-LD schema with 5+ Q&A items about visa eligibility, monthly costs, visa renewal process. Links internally to related blog posts on visa requirements and cost of living.
acceptanceCriteria: Create site/src/app/digital-nomad/page.tsx with hero section, 5+ FAQ items (eligibility, duration, renewal, costs, support), and internal links to /blog posts
FAQPage JSON-LD schema includes mainEntity array with min 5 Question/Answer pairs with proper @type declarations
Page accessible at /digital-nomad with meta description and canonical URL in generateMetadata
technicalNotes: File to create: site/src/app/digital-nomad/page.tsx (React component with FAQPage schema in metadata)
Update site/src/app/sitemap.ts to add route: { url: 'https://pelangi.fyi/digital-nomad', lastModified: new Date() }
Test command: npm run build && rtk curl http://localhost:3000/digital-nomad (verify page loads and schema renders in head)

title: Add blog post tags system with dynamic tag filter pages for long-tail SEO
description: Extend blog system with tagging support. Update posts.ts schema to include tags array (e.g. ['budget', 'transport', 'food']). Create dynamic tag filter page at /blog/tag/[tag] showing all posts with that tag. Update blog index page to display tag badges and tag filter UI.
acceptanceCriteria: Update site/src/data/blog/posts.ts — add tags: string[] field to BlogPost type and populate all 6+ existing posts with relevant tags
Create site/src/app/blog/tag/[tag]/page.tsx with dynamic route that filters posts.ts by tag and renders results with meta tags
Blog index page (site/src/app/blog/page.tsx) displays clickable tag badges below each post card linking to /blog/tag/[tag]
technicalNotes: File to update: site/src/data/blog/posts.ts — add tags field to each post object
File to create: site/src/app/blog/tag/[tag]/page.tsx with generateStaticParams() exporting all unique tags from posts.ts
Test command: npm run build && npx playwright test tests/blog-tags.spec.ts (verify tag pages render and links work)

title: Update sitemap.ts to include all blog posts and tag pages with lastModified dates
description: Extend site/src/app/sitemap.ts to dynamically generate sitemap entries for all blog posts and tag archive pages. Each post includes lastModified date from frontmatter for accurate Google crawl scheduling. Ensures search engines discover new blog content immediately.
acceptanceCriteria: sitemap.ts imports posts.ts and generates URL entry for each post with path /blog/[slug] and lastModified from post.publishedAt
sitemap.ts extracts all unique tags from posts array and generates URL entry for each tag at /blog/tag/[tag]
Sitemap XML validates against sitemap.xml schema with priority 0.8 for blogs and 0.6 for tag pages
technicalNotes: File to update: site/src/app/sitemap.ts — add const posts = await getBlogPosts(); then map over posts and extract/add routes
Import all blog posts or lazy-load from site/src/data/blog/posts.ts directly in sitemap route handler
Test command: rtk curl http://localhost:3000/sitemap.xml | grep -c 'blog/' (verify count matches posts.ts length + unique tags)

title: Create blog post frontmatter Zod schema for build-time validation and type safety
description: Define Zod schema for blog post frontmatter (title, slug, date, author, excerpt, featured, etc.). Validate all posts.ts entries at build time with clear error messages for missing or invalid fields. Auto-generate TypeScript types from schema to ensure compile-time safety.
acceptanceCriteria: Create site/src/lib/blog-frontmatter.ts exporting BlogPostSchema (Zod) with fields: slug, title, publishedAt, author, excerpt (min 20 chars), featured (boolean), category
site/src/data/blog/posts.ts validates all post objects against schema using .parse() at module load or build-time
Build fails with descriptive error if any post is missing required fields or has invalid values (e.g. future publishedAt)
technicalNotes: File to create: site/src/lib/blog-frontmatter.ts with export const BlogPostSchema = z.object({ slug: z.string().min(1), ... })
File to update: site/src/data/blog/posts.ts to add validation: export const posts = BlogPostSchema.array().parse(rawPosts);
Test command: npm run build (should fail if test post has publishedAt in future or missing excerpt); add invalid post temporarily to verify error message
